summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper press against your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The harder part is that neither of you may realize how quickly the tension builds. What starts as a small disagreement can suddenly feel like a fight about something much bigger. One person pushes, the other pushes back, and before long you're both focused on winning the moment instead of understanding each other. The attraction is still there, but it can get buried under the feeling that you always have to defend your position.
advice: This connection works best when you remember that the real challenge is not each other. When you put your energy toward a shared goal, the chemistry becomes a strength instead of a source of friction. The more you focus on solving the problem together, the less likely you are to end up on opposite sides of it.
